Coffee Policy 
 
In May 2025, the Government of Brazil approved Ordinance CMN nº 5.213, allocating the Coffee 
Economy Defense Fund (FUNCAFE) for the 2025/26 harvest. The coffee sector is the only Brazilian 
agribusiness sector with its own fund, comprised of resources originating from the producers. The 
purpose of the funding is to:

Coffee associations in Brazil have generally welcomed these measures, viewing them as necessary
